title: [maintainer] `os doctor` in a freshly scaffolded dev project warns "NODE_ENV Not set — this environment is being treated as production"; beside an `objectstack.config.ts` with no artifact it should read as development
body:
Filing gate: ③ task dispatched by the maintainer, quoted verbatim below; the observation is class (a), this session. The current row is a deliberate outcome of #5673 (PR #5951), so this card records the maintainer's new direction against that ruling rather than a defect in its implementation.
reach: `npx os doctor` in a project just written by `npm create objectstack@latest` (17.7.0) prints `⚠ NODE_ENV  Not set — this environment is being treated as production` and `✓ Environment files  No .env* files here (node_env=production) …`; `npx os dev` in the same directory sets development.
Reader: `domain:cli` seat (`packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`, `nodeEnvCheck()` and `doctorNodeEnv()`; `doctor-env-provenance.test.ts` pins the production default).
Dedup: `search_issues` "os doctor NODE_ENV not set treated as production warning in a dev project objectstack.config.ts" → 4 hits, all closed: #5673 (the ruling that unset reads as production everywhere, and added this doctor row), #5397 and #5387 (doctor and `.env*` loading), #16491 (unrelated test). None covers a source-checkout posture.
Prior rulings read: #5673 / PR #5951 — "NODE_ENV 未设置时 /discovery 报 production,doctor 新增缺省提示行". The safety argument there is about the machine-readable `/discovery` field and `os serve`: a client must never be told "development" by omission. That argument is untouched by this card.
Filed on the maintainer's instruction in this session (category ③, quoted verbatim): 「`os doctor` 在开发项目里警告 "NODE_ENV not set — treated as production"。 刚脚手架完就被告知在跑生产,令人困惑;旁边有 `objectstack.config.ts` 且无产物时应按开发语义判断。」

## Today

The first thing a newcomer sees from `os doctor`, thirty seconds after scaffolding, is a warning that they are running production. The `fix:` text that follows (12 lines) explains the `/discovery` safety rationale and tells them to set `NODE_ENV=development` for local development — which `os dev`, the command the scaffolder's "Next steps" told them to run, already does on its own. Nothing in the project is in production; the warning is about a default the runtime would take in a posture the project is not in.

## Asked for

`doctor` distinguishes the posture it is run in:

- **Source checkout** — cwd holds `objectstack.config.ts` and no `dist/objectstack.json` / `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH`, the posture `os dev` serves: the row reads as development, at `✓`/`ℹ`: `NODE_ENV  Not set — os dev runs this project as development; os start forces production`. No fix text.
- **Artifact / deployment posture** — an artifact present or `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` set, no config: the current `⚠` row and its fix text stay, because that is where #5673's concern (a production deployment that forgot to set it) is real.

The `/discovery` default and `os serve`'s resolution are not changed by this card; only what `doctor` says about them, and when.
